newsitem.title: CHINA: China to cut domestic air fares for foreigners.
newsitem.headline: China to cut domestic air fares for foreigners.

text.p: China will cut air fares for foreign passengers to the same levels as those domestic customers pay as of July 1, a state aviation official said on Friday.
"Prices for foreigners will be reduced to the levels for domestic passengers on all domestic flights," an official of the General Administration of Civil Aviation of China said.
Foreigners currently pay about 25 percent more than domestic passengers for travel inside China.
The official said the move was aimed at boosting domestic air transport.
China is also trying to gain admission to the World Trade Organisation and it has been phasing out some discriminatory pricing policies.
